Motorless Motion Taco Ride

Madison, WI · Bassett · Social

Beginner friendlyNo-drop

Motorless Motion Taco Ride is a social group ride in Madison, WI. It rolls every Wednesday at 6:15 pm from Motorless Motion Bicycles. About 6–8 miles, casual. No-drop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: casual. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at @madisonmomobikes the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Motorless Motion Taco Ride group ride

A short, casual shop ride of 6 to 8 miles, open to all skill levels. Everyone rolls back to the shop for happy hour at Bandit Tacos next door.
